glosses: producer (individual or organization that creates goods and services)
producer (one who produces an artistic production)
creator (one who creates or makes something)

examples.text: A Alemanha é um dos maiores produtores de queijo do mundo.
examples.en: Germany is one of the largest cheese producers in the world.

examples.text: A China é o maior produtor mundial de arroz.
examples.en: China is the world's leading producer of rice.
